lines.en: I press across the ground toward you.

lines.zh: 我的身体沉得像灌了铅。
lines.en: My body is heavy as lead.
I grind forward segment by segment.
I shove the stone out of my way.
Every segment settles, none of it sways.
My shell knocks against the ground.

lines.zh: 拐弯费劲，我半圈半圈转。
lines.en: Turning is slow work, half a circle at a time.

lines.zh: 我顺着塌下的土一路碾下。
lines.en: I grind down the slope with the sliding earth.

lines.zh: 我走过去时草都压平了。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I pass.

lines.zh: 影子先到，身子随后压来。
lines.en: Shadow first, then the weight of me.

lines.zh: 身子还没动，头先探出去。
lines.en: My head probes out before my body moves.

lines.zh: 土层厚，我耗得起这一趟。
lines.en: The soil is deep, I can afford the wait.
I go around the puddle.

lines.zh: 我拖着沉重的身体前进。
lines.en: I haul my heavy body forward.
Where the grass shivers, that is my road.
A dull sheen moves on my shell.
I lie on the ground, heavy.
My feelers sway slowly.
I wait for someone to step in range.
I do not breathe, I only quiver.
My shell glints in the dark.
I hold my body in a coil, quiet.
I slowly lift my front half.
Head laid in the dirt, listening far off.
My body swells once.
I listen to the vibration underfoot.
I press to the soil and hold.
My tail end sweeps the ground.
I raise my heavy head.

lines.zh: 触须抬起来，试着你的味道。
lines.en: My feelers rise to taste your scent.
My eyes are small and fixed.

lines.zh: 近得我能数清你的骨头。
lines.en: Close enough for me to count your bones.
I stare and do not let go.
My body turns toward you.
I am weighing you.
I wait for you to make the first mistake.
My shell looks hard in the light.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向努了努头。
lines.en: I push my head your way.

lines.zh: 壳背上开了口子，土往里灌。
lines.en: A crack in my shell and soil seeps in.

lines.zh: 退了半格，我把重心钉死。
lines.en: Half a block back, I nail my weight down.
I make no sound, only flinch.
My segments grind audibly.

lines.zh: 我把身子盘成一座土丘。
lines.en: I coil my length into a mound of earth.
I lower my front half slowly.
My feelers pull back.
Soil sloughs off my back in sheets.
I stare at you, heavier now.
I settle my weight lower.
I glance and hold still.
That iron is not enough to chew.
I press it into the soil.
I nudge it with a feeler.
I would rather fight you.

lines.zh: 这点碎铁，碍不着我的路。
lines.en: Scrap like that will not block my way.
My mouth is not made for that.
I look a long while and do not move.
It cracks beneath me.
That iron is too small to lift my head for.
You hit me like I am a wall.
My shell shoves you back.
You are pushed four blocks.
I am barely shifted.
The impact sounds dull.
You are tripped to the ground.
I shift aside and leave a narrow gap.
Dirt shakes off me.
You press your chest and gasp.
I set my body firmer.
Two huge forms lie close.
Two shells pressed close, neither gives ground.
It lays its feelers on my head.
We burrow into the earth together.
Our bodies lie side by side.
It shifts; so do I.
We listen to the ground together.

lines.zh: 它们之间没有半点声音。
lines.en: Not a whisper passes between them.
Our heads rest together.
We shift deeper together.
I coil my body around it.

lines.zh: 我用额头顶着它滑出去。
lines.en: I shove it sliding with my brow.

lines.zh: 我用身下的泥把它埋严。
lines.en: I bury it deep in the mud beneath me.
It wedges between my segments.
I drag it along a while.
I look and drop it.
I push it onto a stone.
It is heavier than I expected.

lines.zh: 我把它压在腹下带着走。
lines.en: I carry it pressed under my belly.

lines.zh: 我用触须卷住它的一角。
lines.en: I hook one corner with a feeler.
I stop and look that way.
I feel the vibration of something alive.
I slowly turn my body.
I begin heading there.
I raise my front half.
You are the one I picked.
My feelers straighten forward.

lines.zh: 这声脚步，我以后再不会听错。
lines.en: That footfall I will never mistake again.

lines.zh: 我的身体绷得比刚才紧。
lines.en: My body pulls tighter.
You are already in range.

lines.zh: 你的方向已经钉进我的身子里。
lines.en: Your direction is nailed into my body.
I start moving, my heading fixed.
I follow the sound of your steps.
Wherever you run, the ground rings.
I drive you toward the open ground.
I am not fast, but I keep up.
My feelers point at you.
You look back and I am not far.

lines.zh: 距离在我身下慢慢化掉。
lines.en: The gap melts away beneath me.
You can hear my shell knocking.
I go around your fire.
You have backed into the rubble.

lines.zh: 你听那闷响，就在后颈边。
lines.en: Hear that low thud, right at your nape.
I come around from below the slope.

lines.zh: 我把整条身子的重量砸过去。
lines.en: I hurl the whole weight of my length.
My head shoves you back.
I press in segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我的壳边缘刮破你的皮。
lines.en: My shell's edge scrapes your skin.
I pin you beneath me.
You block and get pushed sliding.
I lash my head into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 触须一圈，勒住你的上臂。
lines.en: One loop of feeler cinches your upper arm.

lines.zh: 你腾空飞出去，落地很远。
lines.en: You leave the ground and land far off.

lines.zh: 我压下去时地面都陷了。
lines.en: The ground sinks when I press down.
A mound of soil bulges up.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，非常沉。
lines.en: I push out of the soil, very heavy.

lines.zh: 这里的草忽然倒了一片。
lines.en: A patch of grass suddenly goes flat.
You hear a heavy sound.
My shell breaks the soil first.
I begin moving in this area.

lines.zh: 一个巨大的影子压过来。
lines.en: A huge shadow falls.
Soil slides off my back.
I begin to exist on the ground.
The ground under you shakes once.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的壳，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Fire touches my shell and I recoil.
I slam into the dirt and dig myself a well.
Water seeps between my segments, cold.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，露出腹部。
lines.en: The blast flips me, baring my underside.

lines.zh: 箭射在我的壳上，弹开了。
lines.en: An arrow hits my shell and bounces off.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进了我的节间。
lines.en: That force works between my segments.
Hunger leaves me unable to shift.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的壳全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shell lights up.

lines.zh: 下面的土没了，我整块下坠。
lines.en: The soil is gone and I fall whole.
